gaps.sentence: The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
